findings.name: Right pleural effusion
findings.note: A massive effusion filling almost the whole right pleural cavity.

findings.name: Right lung compressed by effusion
findings.note: All that is left aerated of the right lung, squashed up against the apex.

findings.name: Mediastinum shifted to the left
findings.note: Fluid under pressure pushes the heart and trachea away from the side it is on.

findings.name: Small bilateral pleural effusions
findings.note: Small effusions blunting both costophrenic angles, as in heart failure.

findings.name: Collapsed left lung (pneumothorax)
findings.note: Air in the pleural space has let the left lung fall away from the chest wall.

findings.name: Air in the left pleural space
findings.note: The pleural cavity the lung has retreated from - no lung markings out here.

findings.name: Consolidated right middle lobe
findings.note: The right middle lobe filled with inflammatory exudate instead of air.

findings.name: Enlarged heart
findings.note: The cardiac silhouette of a dilated heart, over half the width of the chest.

findings.name: Soft tissue of head and neck (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of trunk (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of right upper limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of left upper limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of right lower limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Soft tissue of left lower limb (section fill)
findings.note: Fat, connective tissue and everything else under the skin that the atlas does not model as a named structure, shown only in scan sections so the cut reads as tissue.

findings.name: Left acetabular anterior column fragment
findings.note: A fragment of the anterior column of the left acetabulum, displaced from the socket rim.

findings.name: Left acetabular comminuted fragments
findings.note: Several small loose bone fragments in the left acetabulum, the comminution the source describes.

findings.name: Left acetabular fracture line
findings.note: The fracture line crossing the left acetabulum from the posterior column to the anterior column.

findings.name: Left acetabular posterior column fragment
findings.note: A displaced fragment of the posterior column of the left acetabulum, part of a comminuted fracture.

findings.name: Left renal calculus
findings.note: A small dense calculus in the left kidney, near the renal pelvis; it is bright on non-contrast CT.

findings.name: Right renal calculus
findings.note: A small dense calculus in the lower, medial part of the right kidney; it is bright on non-contrast CT.

findings.name: Left subdural haematoma (convexity)
findings.note: Acute blood lying as a crescent between the left lateral cerebral convexity and the inner table of the skull, the thicker collection on this scan. Confined to the outer convexity so it does not fill the sylvian fissure.

findings.name: Right subdural haematoma (convexity)
findings.note: A thinner crescent of acute blood between the right frontoparietal convexity and the skull, the second collection on this scan. Confined to the outer convexity.

findings.name: Right proximal ureteric stone
findings.note: A calculus lodged in the right proximal ureter just below the renal pelvis, the obstructing stone described in the source.

findings.name: Left lobar pulmonary embolus
findings.note: Clot extending from the bifurcation into the left pulmonary artery.

findings.name: Right lobar pulmonary embolus
findings.note: Clot extending from the bifurcation into the right pulmonary artery.

findings.name: Saddle pulmonary embolus
findings.note: A saddle clot sits across the pulmonary arterial bifurcation and extends into both pulmonary arteries.

findings.name: T10 Chance fracture
findings.note: A horizontal (Chance) fracture runs through the T10 vertebral body and posterior elements after a seatbelt injury in a motor vehicle collision.

findings.name: T9 vertebral body fracture
findings.note: An associated fracture through the T9 vertebral body from the same seatbelt injury.

findings.name: Aortic dissection flap
findings.note: The intimal flap splitting the descending thoracic aorta into a true and a false lumen, as in a Stanford type B dissection.

findings.name: Transverse myelitis central cord hyperintensity
findings.note: Increased central T2 signal in a segment of the cervical cord, the MRI sign of transverse myelitis (inflammation across the cord).

findings.name: Common bile duct stone
findings.note: A stone lodged in the distal common bile duct, causing a filling defect in the otherwise fluid-filled duct on MRCP.

findings.name: Gallbladder stones
findings.note: Multiple gallstones in the gallbladder, seen as filling defects in the fluid-filled gallbladder on MRCP. Drawn on the anterior wall so they stay visible through the opaque gallbladder.

findings.name: Dilated left ventricle
findings.note: The left ventricular cavity is enlarged and rounded, as in the left image. This shows chamber size only; contractility and ejection fraction are not reported.

findings.name: Left basal ganglia infarct
findings.note: Hyperacute left basal ganglia infarction: restricted diffusion, bright on DWI and low on ADC four hours after onset. Conventional T2 did not show it clearly.

findings.name: L4-L5 left paramedian disc herniation
findings.note: Posterior herniation of the L4–L5 disc, left paramedian, indenting the thecal sac and the emerging left L5 root sheath. Enlarged so it reads at the lumbar framing; drawn in a contrasting colour against the disc and canal.

findings.name: Second uterine fibroid (illustrative)
findings.note: Second uterine fibroid in the central pelvis, shown illustratively next to the first.

findings.name: Uterine fibroid (illustrative)
findings.note: Well-circumscribed uterine fibroid (leiomyoma) in the central pelvis, shown illustratively. The atlas has no uterus, so its position is approximate.

findings.name: Right frontal cortical infarct
findings.note: Subacute cortical infarct of the right frontal lobe: restricted diffusion on DWI with gadolinium enhancement of the cortex on enhanced T1 from blood-brain-barrier disruption.

findings.name: Supraspinatus tendon tear
findings.note: Complete full-thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon, about 2.4 cm wide, with the gap filled by fluid.

findings.name: Left basal ganglia infarct (mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc)
findings.note: Hyperacute infarction of the left basal ganglia: restricted diffusion with low ADC, bright on the paired DWI.

findings.name: Left medial thalamic FLAIR signal abnormality
findings.note: Hyperintense FLAIR signal in the left mesial dorsal thalamus, the abnormality described in Wernicke encephalopathy (oedema or gliosis; illustrative marker, not registered to this scan).

findings.name: Right medial thalamic FLAIR signal abnormality
findings.note: Hyperintense FLAIR signal in the right mesial dorsal thalamus, the abnormality described in Wernicke encephalopathy (oedema or gliosis; illustrative marker, not registered to this scan).

findings.name: Left breast (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative breast on the chest wall, shown for the mammogram. The atlas has no breast, so its shape and size are schematic. The source image does not state laterality.

findings.name: Vascular calcification (illustrative) 1
findings.note: Thin curving calcified vessel segment in the upper breast running forward from the cancer, shown illustratively.

findings.name: Vascular calcification (illustrative) 2
findings.note: Second segment of the curving calcified vessel, continuing forward and rising slightly toward the nipple.

findings.name: Right breast (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative breast with fatty outer tissue. It is not a registration of this scan.

findings.name: Left breast (illustrative) (mammo_vascular_calcification)
findings.note: Illustrative breast outline for the mammogram; the calcifications lie within it.

findings.name: Vascular breast calcification
findings.note: Curvilinear calcification in the wall of a breast artery, a thin meandering line within the breast tissue (one stretch of the polyline).

findings.name: Dilated oesophagus in achalasia
findings.note: The lower oesophageal sphincter fails to relax, so the oesophagus dilates above it and fills with retained barium and food. Drawn solid white like the radio-opaque barium column.

findings.name: Barium in left basal segmental bronchi
findings.note: Barium carried on from the lower-lobe bronchus down the posterior basal segmental bronchus, part of the branching contrast seen on the scan.

findings.name: Barium in left lower-lobe bronchus
findings.note: Barium drawn into the left lower-lobe bronchus during a swallow. It is shown as a fluid-filled tube in the lumen, so the contrast of the airway can be matched to the scan.

findings.name: Killian-Jamieson diverticulum
findings.note: A small lateral outpouching of the cervical oesophagus just below the cricopharyngeus, retaining contrast on the barium swallow.

findings.name: Circumflex coronary stenosis
findings.note: Critical narrowing of the proximal circumflex artery, the lesion marked by the source's red arrow. The plaque is illustrative.

findings.name: Left main coronary stenosis
findings.note: Critical atheromatous narrowing of the proximal left main coronary artery, the lesion marked by the source's red arrow. The plaque is illustrative.

findings.name: Cerebral arterial aneurysm
findings.note: A rounded saccular outpouching of an intracranial artery on catheter angiography, with the sac filled by contrast.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 1
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: one bead of the string-of-beads contour, a bulge wider than the thin vessel.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 2
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: one bead of the string-of-beads contour, a bulge wider than the thin vessel.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 3
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: one bead of the string-of-beads contour, a bulge wider than the thin vessel.

findings.name: Right renal artery distal aneurysm
findings.note: A small saccular aneurysm of the distal right renal artery, as described in the source image.

findings.name: Collateral vessels around the occlusion
findings.note: Small collateral channels bridge from the fibular artery to the posterior tibial territory and carry blood around the occlusion.

findings.name: Posterior tibial artery occlusion
findings.note: A clot fills the posterior tibial artery from its origin to the ankle, so it is not opacified on the angiogram.

findings.name: Proximal femoral occlusion
findings.note: A thrombus fills the upper femoral artery, so contrast does not pass beyond it.

findings.name: Left subcapital insufficiency fracture
findings.note: Focal tracer uptake at the left subcapital femoral neck, the insufficiency fracture the bone scan shows.

findings.name: Multinodular goitre nodules
findings.note: Several nodules of different sizes across both lobes of the thyroid (right lobe here, left lobe in the companion finding). The model shows where the nodules sit, not the hot and cold uptake.

findings.name: Toxic adenoma
findings.note: A dominant hot nodule in the thyroid; the rest of the gland is suppressed on the scan. The model shows the nodule's position and size, not its uptake.

findings.name: Left lower lobe pulmonary embolus
findings.note: A clot lodged in a left pulmonary artery branch to the lower lobe, explaining the medial lower-zone perfusion defect with preserved ventilation.

findings.name: Severe coronary stenosis
findings.note: Severe narrowing of a coronary artery on the angiogram (panel C). The source does not name the branch, so the mid anterior interventricular (LAD) artery is shown as an illustrative site.

findings.name: Hodgkin paratracheal nodal mass
findings.note: FDG-avid enlarged mediastinal lymph node mass anterior and to the right of the trachea (right paratracheal / pretracheal station), typical of Hodgkin lymphoma. Shown as an illustrative mass in a hot orange; the 3D atlas is not registered to this scan.

findings.name: Left ICA complete occlusion
findings.note: Thrombus filling the left internal carotid artery, giving the complete occlusion described by the source; the clot is illustrative and is not seen directly on the B-mode image.

findings.name: Common carotid intimal flap (dissection)
findings.note: A thin intimal flap lies within the common carotid artery and separates two lumen channels. The source does not state the side or which channel is the true lumen; the left side is shown for illustration only.

findings.name: Left ICA near-occlusion plaque
findings.note: Atheromatous plaque narrowing the left internal carotid artery lumen to near occlusion, with only residual flow.

findings.name: Paraovarian cyst (right adnexa)
findings.note: Fluid-filled paraovarian cyst in the right broad ligament beside the ovary, about 5 cm across, with a papillary projection on its wall; the adjacent right fallopian tube was torsed, confirmed at laparoscopy.

findings.name: Hydronephrosis (dilated renal pelvis)
findings.note: Obstructed urine backs up and balloons the renal pelvis, which fills most of the renal sinus under a thinned cortex; on ultrasound it is a large anechoic space.

findings.name: Biliary sludge (dependent layer)
findings.note: Mixed echoes of biliary sludge layering on the posterior wall of the gallbladder lumen beneath the stones.

findings.name: Gallstones (dependent, shadowing)
findings.note: Echogenic gallstones lying in the dependent (posterior) part of the gallbladder lumen, producing posterior acoustic shadowing.

findings.name: Gallbladder wall thickening
findings.note: Thickened gallbladder wall (about 4 mm) from acute inflammation, as reported with the cholecystitis.

findings.name: Impacted gallstone
findings.note: A stone of about 1.9 cm impacted at the gallbladder neck, the cause of the acoustic shadow behind it on ultrasound.

findings.name: Hashimoto thyroiditis enlarged right lobe
findings.note: Diffuse lymphocytic inflammation enlarges and darkens the right thyroid lobe on ultrasound; the lobe is hypoechoic and heterogeneous.

findings.name: Femoral vein thrombus
findings.note: Thrombus filling the femoral vein; the vein lacks colour flow on Doppler, while the femoral artery and deep femoral vein fill with colour.

findings.name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
findings.note: Focal dilatation of the abdominal aorta lying in front of the L1 vertebral body, seen in transverse section; the image shows enlargement without a calibrated diameter.

findings.name: Baker's cyst fluid
findings.note: A fluid collection in the popliteal fossa between the semimembranosus tendon and the medial head of gastrocnemius, seen as an elongated anechoic cyst on longitudinal ultrasound.

findings.name: Dilated small bowel with air-fluid levels
findings.note: Distended small bowel loops hold fluid with gas above, giving horizontal air-fluid levels on the upright film. A single projection does not show the transition point.

findings.name: L3 compression fracture
findings.note: Anterior-superior wedge collapse of the L3 vertebral body with reduced height and depression of the upper endplate.

findings.name: Distal radius fracture
findings.note: Transverse fracture through the distal radial metaphysis with the distal fragment displaced dorsally (Colles pattern).

findings.name: Dorsally displaced radial fragment
findings.note: Distal radial fragment displaced dorsally at the Colles fracture site.

findings.name: Ulnar styloid fracture
findings.note: Fracture of the ulnar styloid process at the distal ulna, with a small separated tip fragment.

findings.name: Clavicular fracture
findings.note: Transverse fracture of the mid-shaft of the left clavicle with separated fragments.

findings.name: Calcaneal fracture line
findings.note: Fracture line through the body of the calcaneus, seen as a disrupted heel-bone contour on the lateral radiograph.

findings.name: Left renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Radiopaque calculus in the left kidney near the hilum, seen on the frontal abdominal radiograph.

findings.name: Right renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Radiopaque calculus in the right kidney near the hilum, seen on the frontal abdominal radiograph.

findings.name: Left pleural air (pneumothorax)
findings.note: Air in the left pleural space between the collapsed lung and the chest wall, outside the visceral pleural line.

findings.name: Dilated upper lobe vessels
findings.note: Upper-lobe arteries and veins are equal to or wider than the lower-lobe ones: blood diverted to the upper zones as pulmonary venous pressure rises.

findings.name: Nipple (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative nipple at the anterior tip of the breast.

findings.name: Small breast cancer (illustrative)
findings.note: Small irregular mass in the upper breast near the chest wall at the arrowed site, about 9 mm across, shown illustratively. The source identifies it as cancerous; histological type and BI-RADS are not supplied.

findings.name: Breast skin (illustrative)
findings.note: Small illustrative patch of skin on the anterior-lateral surface of the breast. The atlas has no skin structure, so this patch stands for the skin line seen on the mammogram.

findings.name: Fibroglandular tissue (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative cluster of small glandular nodules inside the breast, away from the cancer, standing for the dense fibroglandular tissue on the mammogram. The atlas has no glandular tissue, so the nodules are schematic.

findings.name: Fibroglandular core (illustrative)
findings.note: Dense fibroglandular tissue inside the illustrative breast.

findings.name: Adipose tissue of breast (illustrative)
findings.note: Radiolucent fatty breast tissue lying outside the glandular core. Illustrative, not a registration of this scan.

findings.name: Nipple (illustrative) (mammo_vascular_calcification)
findings.note: Illustrative nipple at the anterior tip of the breast; on the scan it is an imaging marker, not a lesion.

findings.name: Separate breast calcification
findings.note: A separate punctate calcification within the breast tissue.

findings.name: Grouped calcifications (illustrative)
findings.note: Grouped microcalcifications in the glandular tissue, as marked by the source annotations. Malignancy is not established.

findings.name: Kerley B line right base upper (cxr_chf)
findings.note: Kerley B line: a thickened interlobular septum at the right lung base, the interstitial oedema of raised pulmonary venous pressure.

findings.name: Kerley B line right base lower (cxr_chf)
findings.note: Kerley B line: a thickened interlobular septum at the right lung base, the interstitial oedema of raised pulmonary venous pressure.

findings.name: Kerley B line left base upper (cxr_chf)
findings.note: Kerley B line: a thickened interlobular septum at the left lung base, the interstitial oedema of raised pulmonary venous pressure.

findings.name: Kerley B line left base lower (cxr_chf)
findings.note: Kerley B line: a thickened interlobular septum at the left lung base, the interstitial oedema of raised pulmonary venous pressure.

findings.name: Barium in oesophagus (fluoro_aspiration)
findings.note: Continuous column of barium filling the oesophagus during the swallow, following its S-shaped course (posterior in the mid chest, forward again at the hiatus); the source of the aspirated contrast on the scan.

findings.name: Intrauterine adhesions (illustrative) (fluoro_hsg_adhesions)
findings.note: Fibrous adhesions bridging the uterine cavity (Asherman syndrome), shown illustratively. The atlas has no uterus, so the position is approximate.

findings.name: Nonspecific ductal calcification (illustrative) (mammo_nonspecific_abnormal)
findings.note: Nonspecific ductal-pattern calcification, as the source describes it: a linear scatter of small calcifications running toward the nipple along the ducts. Not necessarily cancer. Illustrative; not a registration of this scan, and drawn larger than real microcalcifications so it can be seen.

findings.name: Left kidney impaired function marker (illustrative) (nuclear_renal_function)
findings.note: Illustrative marker over the posterior face of the left kidney for its markedly impaired function: weak DTPA and MAG3 uptake with a flat renogram, in a thromboembolic disease case. The source does not name the lesion; the clot-coloured solid blob is a placeholder so the marker stands out from the kidney.

findings.name: Focal hepatic steatosis (illustrative) (us_focal_steatosis)
findings.note: Illustrative echogenic focus of focal fatty change in the liver, inside segment V and crossed by a hepatic vein. No fat material exists, so body soft tissue is used. Not a tumour.

findings.name: Inflamed appendix wall (illustrative) (ct_appendicitis)
findings.note: Illustrative thickened, inflamed wall of the vermiform appendix (enlarged, thick-walled, over 6 mm outer diameter is the CT criterion). Reference position, not localized to this scan.

findings.name: Vascular breast calcification lower segment (mammo_vascular_calcification)
findings.note: Curvilinear calcification in the wall of a breast artery, a thin meandering line within the breast tissue (one stretch of the polyline).

findings.name: Gravid uterus 12 weeks CRL (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative uterus at about 12 weeks, lying above the bladder and enclosing the fetus. The atlas has no uterus.

findings.name: Fetus 12 weeks CRL (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative fetus at about 12 weeks inside the uterus. Long axis runs anterior-posterior, head end anterior, so the crown-rump line lies along it.

findings.name: Fetal head 12 weeks CRL (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative fetal head at the crown end of the crown-rump length.

findings.name: Right middle lobe consolidation (illustrative) (ct_pneumonia)
findings.note: Illustrative solid airspace consolidation filling part of the right middle lobe against the heart border, as on the CT.

findings.name: Fluid in right horizontal fissure (cxr_chf)
findings.note: Fluid tracking into the right horizontal fissure, on the top of the middle lobe between the superior and middle lobes: the earliest effusion seen on a film.

findings.name: L5-S1 posterior disc overhang
findings.note: Mild posterior overhang of the L5-S1 disc, circled on the scan. The report describes no obvious root impingement here. Drawn in the same contrasting orange as the L4-L5 herniation so it reads against the canal.

findings.name: Fetal rump 12 weeks CRL (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative rump at the posterior end of the fetus, where the crown-rump length line ends.

findings.name: Vertebra L1 displaced (illustrative) (xr_scoliosis)
findings.note: Illustrative: L1 shifted 8 mm toward the patient's right, one step of a smooth lumbar curve convex to the right with apex at L3 (not registered to the radiograph).

findings.name: Vertebra L2 displaced (illustrative) (xr_scoliosis)
findings.note: Illustrative: L2 shifted 14 mm toward the patient's right, one step of a smooth lumbar curve convex to the right with apex at L3 (not registered to the radiograph).

findings.name: Vertebra L3 displaced (illustrative) (xr_scoliosis)
findings.note: Illustrative: L3 shifted 17 mm toward the patient's right, one step of a smooth lumbar curve convex to the right with apex at L3 (not registered to the radiograph).

findings.name: Vertebra L4 displaced (illustrative) (xr_scoliosis)
findings.note: Illustrative: L4 shifted 12 mm toward the patient's right, one step of a smooth lumbar curve convex to the right with apex at L3 (not registered to the radiograph).

findings.name: Vertebra L5 displaced (illustrative) (xr_scoliosis)
findings.note: Illustrative: L5 shifted 5 mm toward the patient's right, one step of a smooth lumbar curve convex to the right with apex at L3 (not registered to the radiograph).

findings.name: Nipple (mammo small cancer)
findings.note: Illustrative nipple at the anterior tip of the breast.

findings.name: Breast skin (mammo small cancer)
findings.note: Small illustrative patch of skin on the anterior-lateral surface of the breast. The atlas has no skin structure, so this patch stands for the skin line seen on the mammogram.

findings.name: Fibroglandular tissue (mammo small cancer)
findings.note: Illustrative cluster of small glandular nodules inside the breast, away from the cancer, standing for the dense fibroglandular tissue on the mammogram. The atlas has no glandular tissue, so the nodules are schematic.

findings.name: Traversing hepatic vein (illustrative) (us_focal_steatosis)
findings.note: Illustrative hepatic vein running diagonally through the echogenic focus without compression, drawn as a finding so it stays visible where the focus covers the atlas vein. A normal vein; the vessel material is the closest available.

findings.name: Posterior tibial artery occlusion, segment 2 (angio_foot_occlusion)
findings.note: A clot fills the posterior tibial artery from its origin to the ankle, so it is not opacified on the angiogram.

findings.name: Posterior tibial artery occlusion, segment 3 (angio_foot_occlusion)
findings.note: A clot fills the posterior tibial artery from its origin to the ankle, so it is not opacified on the angiogram.

findings.name: Posterior tibial artery occlusion, segment 6 (angio_foot_occlusion)
findings.note: A clot fills the posterior tibial artery from its origin to the ankle, so it is not opacified on the angiogram.

findings.name: Collateral vessels around the occlusion, bridge 2 (angio_foot_occlusion)
findings.note: Small collateral channels bridge from the fibular artery to the posterior tibial territory and carry blood around the occlusion.

findings.note: Small collateral channels bridge from the fibular artery to the posterior tibial territory and carry blood around the occlusion.

findings.note: Small collateral channels bridge from the fibular artery to the posterior tibial territory and carry blood around the occlusion.

findings.name: Calcaneal anastomosis collateral (angio_foot_occlusion)
findings.note: Calcaneal branches of the fibular artery join those of the posterior tibial artery at the heel and refill the occluded territory.

findings.name: Distal femoral occlusion
findings.note: A thrombus in the lower femoral artery just above the knee: contrast stops here and the arteries below do not fill.

findings.name: Lower accessory left renal artery (FMD)
findings.note: The thin lower accessory left renal artery of the case (the atlas has none), running below the main left renal artery from the aorta toward the lower pole of the left kidney. Its string-of-beads contour is shown by the beads on it.

findings.name: Left renal artery bead 4
findings.note: Fibromuscular dysplasia of the lower accessory left renal artery: one bead of the string-of-beads contour, a bulge wider than the thin vessel.

findings.name: Left subdural haematoma (frontal convexity)
findings.note: The anterior continuation of the left subdural collection over the frontal convexity, thinner than the lateral part.

findings.name: Right subdural haematoma (frontal convexity)
findings.note: The anterior continuation of the thin right subdural collection over the frontal convexity.

findings.name: Chemotherapy port reservoir (illustrative) (cxr_pneumothorax)
findings.note: Illustrative subcutaneous port reservoir on the left anterior chest wall: the radiodense ring seen below the clavicle on the film.

findings.name: Port catheter (illustrative) (cxr_pneumothorax)
findings.note: Illustrative port catheter running from the reservoir up to the left subclavian vein, then through the brachiocephalic vein to the SVC.

findings.name: Achalasia distal funnel of dilated oesophagus
findings.note: Barium-filled lower end of the dilated oesophagus, rounding off into the narrow bird-beak segment above the closed sphincter. Drawn solid white like the radio-opaque barium column.

findings.name: Barium in oesophagus segment 2 (fluoro_aspiration)
findings.note: Next stretch of the barium column in the oesophagus, following its curved course.

findings.name: Barium in left anterior basal bronchus (fluoro_aspiration)
findings.note: Aspirated barium in the anterior basal segmental bronchus, a further branch of the left lower-lobe airway tree.

findings.name: Barium in left lateral basal bronchus (fluoro_aspiration)
findings.note: Aspirated barium in the lateral basal segmental bronchus, a further branch of the left lower-lobe airway tree.

findings.note: Aspirated barium in the medial basal segmental bronchus, a further branch of the left lower-lobe airway tree.

findings.note: Illustrative broad cluster of glandular nodules filling the central breast, standing for the large area of dense fibroglandular tissue on the mammogram. Schematic; the atlas has no glandular tissue.

findings.name: Lumbar thecal sac CSF (upper)
findings.note: Fluid-filled dural (thecal) sac in the lumbar canal, bright on T2 MRI, running down behind the L2 to L5 vertebral bodies. The L4–L5 herniation indents its anterior wall.

findings.name: Lumbar thecal sac CSF (lower)
findings.note: Lower part of the fluid-filled thecal sac, passing behind the L4–L5 and L5–S1 discs towards the sacral canal. The L5–S1 disc overhangs its anterior wall without obvious root impingement.

findings.name: Left lobe goitre nodules (nuclear_thyroid_patterns)
findings.note: Nodules of different sizes in the left lobe of the thyroid. The model shows where the nodules sit, not the hot and cold uptake.

findings.name: Right lower-pole renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Second, smaller calculus in the right kidney's lower pole; the film shows several foci per side.

findings.name: Left upper-pole renal calculus (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Second, smaller calculus in the left kidney's upper pole; the film shows several foci per side.

findings.name: Right pelvic phlebolith A (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Rounded calcification in the right pelvic venous plexus, outside the urinary tract.

findings.name: Right pelvic phlebolith B (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Second rounded calcification in the right pelvic venous plexus.

findings.name: Left pelvic phlebolith A (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Rounded calcification in the left pelvic venous plexus, outside the urinary tract.

findings.name: Left pelvic phlebolith B (xr_bilateral_renal_stones)
findings.note: Second rounded calcification in the left pelvic venous plexus.

findings.name: Left clavicle midshaft fracture zone
findings.note: Mid-shaft break of the left clavicle: the fracture zone crosses the whole shaft, interrupting both the superior and inferior cortex, between the medial and lateral fragments.

findings.name: Fetal CRL measurement line (illustrative)
findings.note: Illustrative crown-rump length line, about 65 mm, running from the crown of the head to the rump along the fetus.

findings.name: Redundant colonic loop 01 (illustrative) (fluoro_dolichocolon)
findings.note: Illustrative only: in dolichocolon the colon is longer than normal and forms redundant loops that sag towards the pelvis. This U-shaped loop hangs from the transverse colon into the lower abdomen. The scout frame alone does not establish it.
